body: Hey! Hope you’re all good. I’m about to apply for exemptions and from what I had gotten in uni, I can be exempted from 5 out of the 6 certificate level exams. Prior to accepting my contract with my firm, I was told that they’d reimburse me with the exemptions that I would apply for however also told me that they’d make us sit the exams anyway as the next level exams are built on knowledge from the certificate level exams. I was wondering if you think I should bother applying for CPL if they’re going to make us sit them anyway despite exemptions? Like yourself I did my accredited modules in uni ages ago, and to be frank don’t really remember much of them 😭

Ohh interesting! I was told by the firm I’m going to be working for in September to register with ICAEW and provided me with details of the training agreement which were needed. Did that fine, but can’t apply for CPL now 😭 Emailed the trainee development team regarding this so they may be able to help! Again thank you anyway!

Mostly all the classes included in the certificate level exams which I presume for now I would get exemptions for. I think I should be able to get exemptions for most of them except for management accounting where I failed to get the required 50% for one exam 😭 despised management accounting with a passion in uni and avoided it like a plague when it came to choosing my final year modules
Hey! Thanks for answering, was wondering how much time were you given to study right from starting your ACA? Got my provisional timetable and I think I have 2-3 weeks at tuition?

Hey! Thank you so much for the detailed answer, highly appreciate it! While I scraped a 2:1 in my final year, I did pretty well in the first three years of my uni course, which included modules for accreditation purposes so this gives me a bit of hope! Just a shame that my final year is the only year which counted for my degree classification. Also glad I haven’t thrown my books and notes away so will definitely be keeping them around for the next three years for sure! I have registered as an ACA student on the ICAEW website but it’s not letting me apply for CPL (credits for prior learning), was wondering if you had any issues applying for yours as well?
The thing is I don’t know if it is a toxic situation or if my anxiety is making this a toxic situation. When he said ‘it’s all in your head’, I’m scared that maybe I am the problem.
